_comment: 生成物，别手改。scripts/export-codex.ts 从 data/vanilla/units 与 vanilla-assets.json 生成。

desc.zh: 只要心中破晓信念未灭，将士的步履与刀锋便决不动摇。
desc.en: So long as their faith in the dawn endures, neither their stride nor their blades shall falter.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以在部署区域外进行部署
desc.en: This unit can deploy outside the deployment zone.

desc.zh: 这支部队免疫心理攻击（恐惧与惊骇）
desc.en: The unit is immune to psychological attacks (Fear & Terror).

desc.zh: 这支部队可以在移动的同时进行射击
desc.en: This unit can fire while on the move.

desc.zh: 这支部队在任何地形上移动时都会保持隐蔽
desc.en: This unit can move hidden in any terrain.

desc.zh: 这支部队不受因地形导致的速度与战斗惩罚
desc.en: Speed and combat penalties caused by terrain are ignored by this unit.
